CVE-2026-109968.title: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-pkcs11-afu ...
CVE-2026-109968.description: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-pkcs11-afunix-socket-unlock daemon logs LUKS disk encryption passphrases in plaintext to a log file. The log file is created without restrictive permissions, making it world-readable under the default process umask. A local attacker can read the log file to obtain the LUKS passphrase.

CVE-2026-109969.title: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-pkcs11-afu ...
CVE-2026-109969.description: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-pkcs11-afunix-socket-unlock daemon creates AF_UNIX sockets without explicit permission restrictions or peer credential verification. Under a permissive process umask, any local user can connect to the control socket and inject arbitrary device/key pairs, or connect to the data socket to receive LUKS passphrases.

CVE-2026-109970.title: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-luks-pkcs1 ...
CVE-2026-109970.description: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-luks-pkcs11-askpin script writes the PKCS#11 token PIN in plaintext to a file without setting restrictive permissions. Under the default process umask, the file is world-readable. Additionally, the PIN file is not reliably cleaned up if the decryption script exits early, leaving the PIN accessible indefinitely.

CVE-2026-109971.title: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-decrypt-pk ...
CVE-2026-109971.description: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-decrypt-pkcs11 script passes the PKCS#11 token PIN as a command-line argument to pkcs11-tool, making it visible to any local user through process listing or the /proc filesystem.

CVE-2026-109976.title: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-pkcs11-afu ...
CVE-2026-109976.description: A flaw was found in the clevis PKCS#11 pin. The clevis-pkcs11-afunix-socket-unlock daemon crashes when an AF_UNIX client connects to the data socket without a bound address, due to an integer underflow in the getpeername result handling. This causes a denial of service, preventing LUKS disk decryption from completing during boot.
